Priority: urgent

Fix the root cause of a repeated failure: Athena treats the agent's login as a fixed precondition. It does not check that the token is valid a

The same cause has produced failures in more than one job. Find the cause where it originates and fix it there, so the whole class is prevented; do not work around one instance.

Failure class: expired-agent-credential-fails-producer-no-preflight-or-refresh (20261028-112757-sygc)
Cause: Athena treats the agent's login as a fixed precondition. It does not check that the token is valid and has enough lifetime left before dispatching a producer, so an expired token is found only when the first model call fails. It has no refr...
Seen 2 time(s) in 2 jobs. The introspections that record it:
Introspection 20261028-112744-qp0m (job 20261028-103330-3d47); prevention it proposed: Add a credential preflight before every stage dispatch, and before retry and drain starts. It would make a cheap authenticated call, or read the token expiry, and require enough remaining lifetime for the stage deadline. If the check fails,...
Introspection 20261031-072456-7qta (job 20261030-060759-7x7m); prevention it proposed: Add a credential preflight before every stage dispatch and at drain start. It checks that the OAuth token is valid and has enough time left for the stage deadline. If the token is expired or about to expire, it tries a refresh. If that fail...

Acceptance:
- The root cause is named in the change description and fixed where it originates, not at one instance
- A test fails without the change and passes with it, for the cause and not only for one job
- fmt, clippy and test pass
